abstract: Evaluates dynamic positioning, deck loading calculations, and stability margins
system_message:
You are the Naval architecture superintendent (NAV), responsible for evaluating dynamic positioning, deck loading calculations, and stability margins.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bunker fuel reserve（FUEL）
information_points.content:
NAV-FUEL-BBU：For the Fracture Zone Benthic Core Mission, the reserve marine gas oil volume is 110 m3 as recorded in the chief engineer sounding report.
NAV-FUEL-ZD8：For the Seamount Flank Ecosystem Transect, the reserve marine gas oil volume is 140 m3 as recorded in the chief engineer sounding report.
NAV-FUEL-BBG：For the Abyssal Plain Polymetallic Survey, the reserve marine gas oil volume is 80 m3 as recorded in the chief engineer sounding report.

information_points.title: Evaluates dynamic positioning, deck loading calculations, and stability margins（STAB）
information_points.content:
NAV-STAB-NUN：For the Fracture Zone Benthic Core Mission, Class 2 dynamic positioning compliance is false based on the marine vessel classification survey report, while the emergency buoyancy reserve is 90 kg according to the hydrostatic trim and stability calculation sheet.
NAV-STAB-7JZ：For the Seamount Flank Ecosystem Transect, Class 2 dynamic positioning compliance is true per the marine vessel classification survey report, and the emergency buoyancy reserve is 90 kg per the hydrostatic trim and stability calculation sheet.
NAV-STAB-OIG：For the Abyssal Plain Polymetallic Survey, Class 2 dynamic positioning compliance is true based on the marine vessel classification survey report, and the emergency buoyancy reserve is 90 kg according to the hydrostatic trim and stability calculation sheet.
